query: My 60-year-old female ICU patient has an instability score of 60 from the first 24 hours. Among female ICU patients aged 55–65 with pneumonia, what percentile is this score? Also report ICU LOS and mortality for the most unstable decile.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_rank, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY percentile_rank) AS num_patients, MAX(los) OVER (PARTITION BY percentile_rank ORDER BY los DESC) AS longest_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN interpretation = 'Mortality' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY percentile_rank) AS num_deaths FROM (SELECT subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id, first_careunit, last_careunit, intime, outtime, los, gender, anchor_age, anchor_year, anchor_year_group, icd_code, test_name, interpretation, (CASE WHEN (outtime - intime) > 24 THEN (outtime - intime) ELSE 24 END) AS instability_score FROM icustays JOIN patients ON icustays.subject_id = patients.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd ON icustays.hadm_id = diagnoses_icd.subject_id JOIN microbiologyevents ON icustays.hadm_id = microbiologyevents.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_age BETWEEN 55 AND 65 AND microbiologyevents.test_name = 'pneumonia' AND microbiologyevents.interpretation = 'Susceptible') subquery) s WHERE percentile_rank <= 0.6;
